structural_checks_passed: All 75 original case IDs present exactly once and in original order
All notes marked labelled, with valid claim fields and enums
Every claim quotation occurs exactly once in its source note
No duplicate claim quotations within a note
Reasoning file contains every uncertain or contradictory claim quotation and every zero-claim note ID
Nonempty reviewer identity and UTC labelling timestamp
delivery.independence_scope: Fresh conversation context and restricted substantive inputs; one AI reviewer, not human ground truth.

prohibited_review_inputs: Answer key and checker or scorer code/tests
Prior controls, labels, adjudications and provenance findings
Other documentation, repository history, wiki and memory
Parent task history or other agents' discussions
procedure: Read all 75 whole notes and their supplied evidence.
Independently identify and adjudicate every in-scope numeric and qualitative claim using the instrument rubric.
Retain exact uniquely occurring quotations and mark every fully reviewed note labelled, including notes with no in-scope claims.
Record reasoning for uncertain or contradictory claims and zero-claim notes separately from the labels.
Parent validates structure and provenance, without revising substantive judgements.
Preserve the delivered labels and reasoning in a local commit before scoring or opening the key.
limitations: Single AI adjudication, not human ground truth or measured inter-rater agreement.
The parent has seen prior findings; none were forwarded to this fresh-context labeller.
Blinding uses fresh context and input restrictions, not an operating-system access restriction.
The labeller may itself omit or misinterpret a claim; structural validation cannot establish extraction completeness or judgement accuracy.
